subject: intr
title: (R)INTR.------INFO.F.
description: Chart on book p. 215 (T(IMP)M-13). INTR (interpretation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; INFO-F (information focus) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY, TRS (transition) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From INFO-DY: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) and IST-F (isolated focus). From CULT-INFO-B: CN-INFO (controlled information). From TRS: MT-INFO (multi-information). From AF-DY: AF-NT (affinity nature). From AF-NT: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) and PER-DY (perception dynamics).
